_comment: Maps a cleaned raw title (as it appeared in chat) to its canonical form. Lookup is case-insensitive. Applied AFTER markdown/quote stripping and AFTER the segment in parentheses is split off.
oh, whistle, and i'll come to you, my la: Oh, Whistle, and I'll Come to You, My Lad
the hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
the night train at deoli & the leopard: The Night Train at Deoli & The Leopard
_no_trailing_parens_comment: The website's session importer reads a trailing '(...)' as the segment and strips it, so a title must never end in one - otherwise works.csv keeps the bracket, sessions.csv loses it, and the two stop matching. The Bengali original title is recorded in work_metadata.json instead.
